title: Slovakian Pork Stew
description: A hearty Slovakian-inspired stew made with tender pork and juicy vegetables.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add pork and cook until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove from pot and set aside.
Add onion and garlic to pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add carrot and potato to pot and cook for 5 minutes.
Add mushroom to pot and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add tomato paste, beef broth, and paprika to pot. Stir to combine.
Return pork to pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, until pork is tender, about 2 hours.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
